notes.title: Early Access Release 0.3.1
notes.content:
Welcome to a little town in the Austrian Alps called Hochboden! This marks the official Early Access Release of "The Shepherd: Black Sheep". Thank you to everyone who contributed in some form or another already!

[h2]Feedback[/h2]
We want to improve and develop this game with you, so your feedback is invaluable to us. Please join our discord or send an E-Mail to support@bandaloop.at to participate.

[h1]The Release: 0.3.0[/h1]
If you played the Demo you will find a few changes:
[list]
[*] Seasons are visually more distinctive (ongoing changes)
[*] Visuals have been improved for most aspects of the game
[*] More music has been added
[*] Localization updates
[/list]

But most importantly:
[list]
[*] Release of Chapter 3: Settled In
[*] Release of Exploration with the first Hiking Area, unlocked in Chapter 3
[/list]

[h3]Additional stuff we got to today for 0.3.1:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed giving gifts to Townspeople
[*] Improved gravity's hold on dog treats, so Rocky can eat them *chomp*
[*] Fixed Spelling and Grammar in German Localization
[/list]

[h1]The Road ahead[/h1]
A small outlook what we have planned for November with Version 0.4.0:
[list]
[*] Training Update for Competitions
[*] Sheepherding and Dog Show Competitions
[*] Chapter 4 release
[*] Graphics overhaul
[*] Tutorials rework
[*] Journal rework
[/list]

[b]Thank you for playing and happy Halloween![/b]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2.2
notes.content:
We've been working hard to integrade Feedback from Gamecity Vienna into the Demo already while working on new features for release, despite team members being sick! We hope you enjoy the Demo and we can't wait to show you what's next.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with VoiceOver
[*] Fixed ItemIcons for Torch and Stick
[*] Improved Rocky's animation handling during training
[*] Fixed a bug in Rocky's Brain causing him to run off for no reason at all
[*] Fixed a bug making Items unusable in Training after having used one before
[*] Improved choice viewport scroll in Dialogues
[*] Fixed an issue with French and German Locales being swapped in some places
[*] Reduced Speed of Herding EdgePan
[*] Fixed Locales in Herding Pop Up
[*] Improved Herding Visuals
[*] Added Cooldown to Herding Commands, reduced whistling
[*] Improved MM & Training Scene Visuals
[*] Fixed a bug blocking a loaded Encounter from finishing
[*] Fixed a bug allowing to take a turn too early in Encounters
[*] Reduced glint in Rocky's Eyes
[*] Improved Tutorials (ongoing)
[*] Added new Hochboden Background Music
[*] Adjusted Audio Mix
[*] Made first trust value lower in Story
[/list]
